experiment: Baseline measurement calibration v1; no new optimizer draws
timeout_policy: Stop the affected query/mode after its first timeout or error; retain all remaining planned slots as explicit skips. Other modes remain eligible.
selection_policy: All twelve frozen pilot queries, default baseline recipes only; no outcome-based query or candidate selection
measurement_policy: One warmup per mode/session; ten blocks with seeded randomized mode order. Fixed query order. Warm cache policy, no claim of cache residency.
scope: Profile server execution time for TIMING ON/OFF; ordinary SELECT client wall includes planning, execution, and result transfer. Do not subtract unlike timing scopes. Plain SELECT has pre/post EXPLAIN checks, not an observed timed plan.
awake_policy: macOS caffeinate -i -s tied to runner lifetime; record UTC and monotonic elapsed times and load. A preselected >1000ms cross-clock discrepancy makes the profile invalid for interpretation. Lid closure and resource contention still require monitoring.
